mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO SM_STMT_TID (SETTLE_DT, MCHT_ID, PAY_METHOD, TR_SEQ, TID, TX_STATUS, AMT, COST_RATE, SALES_RATE, COST_FEE, SALES_FEE, FEE_VAT, MARGIN_AMT, PAYOUT_AMT) VALUES
(#{d.settleDt}, #{d.mchtId}, #{d.payMethod}, #{d.trSeq}, #{d.tid}, #{d.txStatus}, #{d.amt}, #{d.costRate}, #{d.salesRate}, #{d.costFee}, #{d.salesFee}, #{d.feeVat}, #{d.marginAmt}, #{d.payoutAmt})
mapper.select: SELECT SETTLE_DT, MCHT_ID, PAY_METHOD, COUNT(*) AS TX_CNT, SUM(AMT) AS TX_AMT, SUM(COST_FEE) AS COST_FEE, SUM(SALES_FEE) AS SALES_FEE, SUM(FEE_VAT) AS FEE_VAT, SUM(MARGIN_AMT) AS MARGIN_AMT, SUM(PAYOUT_AMT) AS PAYOUT_AMT FROM SM_STMT_TID WHERE SETTLE_DT = #{settleDt} GROUP BY SETTLE_DT, MCHT_ID, PAY_METHOD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SM_STMT (SETTLE_DT, MCHT_ID, PAY_METHOD, TX_CNT, TX_AMT, COST_FEE, SALES_FEE, FEE_VAT, MARGIN_AMT, PAYOUT_AMT, PAYOUT_DT, STMT_ST_CD) VALUES (#{settleDt}, #{mchtId}, #{payMethod}, #{txCnt}, #{txAmt}, #{costFee}, #{salesFee}, #{feeVat}, #{marginAmt}, #{payoutAmt}, #{payoutDt}, '0')
mapper.update: UPDATE SM_STMT SET STMT_ST_CD = '1' WHERE STMT_ST_CD = '0' AND PAYOUT_DT <= #{today}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(SETTLE_DT, '%Y-%m') AS SETTLE_MONTH, MCHT_ID, SUM(TX_CNT) AS TX_CNT, SUM(TX_AMT) AS TX_AMT, SUM(COST_FEE) AS COST_FEE, SUM(SALES_FEE) AS SALES_FEE, SUM(MARGIN_AMT) AS MARGIN_AMT FROM SM_STMT WHERE DATE_FORMAT(SETTLE_DT, '%Y-%m') = #{month} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(SETTLE_DT, '%Y-%m'), MCHT_ID ORDER BY MCHT_ID
